senses.gloss:
नुद् नुद्, i. 6, Par., Ātm. (ii. 2, Hariv. 7442).
 1. To push on, Megh. 9.
 2. To push away, to remove, MBh. 3, 12707; 4, 1819.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. नुत्त, नुन्न, नूत, and in epic poetry also नुदित, MBh. 1, 6670.
 --Caus. नोदय,
 1. To push on, MBh. 9, 1005.
 2. To incite, Rām. 5, 46, 12.
 --With the prep. अप अप,
 1. To drive away, Bhāg. P. 1, 16, 35.
 2. To remove, MBh. 14, 1853.
 --With व्यप वि-अप, To remove, 11, 24.
 --With अभि अभि, To strike, 14, 1718.
 --Caus. To order, 1478.
 --With अव अव, Caus.
 1. To induce to drive away (two acc.), 7, 3069.
 --With अपा अप-आ, (probably अप with lengthened final),
 1. To drive away, 7, 8691.
 2. To remove, 3, 16973.
 3. To expiate, Man. 6, 95.
 --With व्यपा वि-अप-आ (see अपा), To remove, MBh. 4, 1319.
 --With उपा उप-आ (?),
 1. To drive away, 7, 1771.
 2. To remove, 268.
 3. To bruise, 6, 5619.
 --With उप उप, To drive near, Śiś. 4, 68.
 --With निस् निस्, निर्णुद् निर् णुद्,
 1. To reject, Man. 4, 250.
 2. To remove, MBh. 12, 7126.
 --With अभिनिस् To remove, 12, 10728.
 --With परा परा, णुद् णुद्, To remove, Bhāg. P. 3, 7, 7.
 --With प्र प्र, णुद् णुद्,
 1. To drive away, MBh. 4, 1660.
 2. To remove, Rām. 3, 78, 8.
 3. To push on, MBh. 3, 12096.
 4. To stir, Rām. 5, 3, 38.
 --Caus. प्र-णोदित, Agitated, Pañc. 165, 10.
 --With अतिप्र अति-प्र, To press hard, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 14.
 --With अनुप्र अनु-प्र, To put to flight, Rām. 6, 7, 36. []
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र,
 1. To urge, MBh. 3, 377.
 2. To remove, 5, 745.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To strike, to wound, 6, 4846.
 2. To play (as a guitar), Bhāg. P. 4, 8, 38.
 --Caus.
 1. To remove, Śiś. 4, 60.
 2. To spend (as a night), MBh. 3 46.
 3. To exhilarate, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 135.
 --With अभवि अभि-वि, Caus. To exhilarate, MBh. 12, 898.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To collect, 6, 777.
 2. To push on, Nal. 20, 42.
 3. To find, Rām. 5, 1, 92.
 --Cf. A.S. nydian (to compel), a-nydan (to repel); Goth. niutan; A.S. niótan (originally, to further), not, use, perhaps νύσσα.
ऽनुद् -नुद्, latter part of a comp. adj., Removing, Kir. 5, 28.
